title: Find practical RT validation checks and RT option types
objective: Inspect the local SPEAR flashlight/runtime code and recent SM6 cook artifacts to identify practical non-log ways to confirm hardware ray tracing is active, plus the ray tracing/Lumen options exposed or relevant for this project. Return concise commands/checks the user can run without needing to visually search giant Unreal logs.
instructions: Read the relevant local files and result artifacts only; do not modify files.
Focus on examples/flashlight/run.py runtime readback/logging, DefaultEngine.ini SM6 config, and the 2026-07-08 cook verification artifacts.
Include exact grep/rg commands, file/artifact checks, and console/CVar readback ideas if available.

Summarize the different UE ray tracing modes/options relevant here: hardware RT enablement, Lumen hardware RT, Lumen reflections HWRT, shadow ray tracing intent, path tracing/offline distinction, and software Lumen vs hardware RT.
Keep recommendations practical for a live teleop user.
definition_of_done: Tower can answer user with specific commands and clear RT option distinctions
